Selective automation for the wedge model (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; final RMSNorm after each pass; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; untied lm_head; SwiGLU 10752) is STATIC and user-owned first: once a task has a valid calibration artifact, a deterministic policy table can route results — but there is no self-training flywheel, no cloud escalation, and no adaptive controller in v1.

## Contract
- **DecisionPolicy:** a versioned, OFFLINE-FIT, static deterministic table mapping task-valid calibrated signals → `{accept, explicit thinking retry, explicit N-seed aggregate, abstain, review_spill}` under a DECLARED loss table.
- **Cost honesty:** all retries/discards (thinking retries, N-seed aggregates) count in reported cost; every accepted result records the authorizing signals and policy version.
- **Review spill:** spilled items go to explicit human review. Corrections are **selection-biased toward cases the current policy already considered hard** — they can NEVER update accepted-population claims or silently extend a qualification's validity; only an AA-A1 independently sampled audit (known inclusion probabilities, human-authorized grades) may update accepted-population evidence. Corrections imported into an explicitly named local suite may support a later eval/calibrate/policy fit — as an explicit, versioned event.
- **Forbidden:** online learning, prompt mutation, cloud escalation, automatic incorporation into project scorecards, hidden refitting on invalidation. Constraint diagnostics (§7.3 legal-mass/margin) are advisory unless independently calibrated on the same task.
- **Fallback:** ordinary task output/abstention is the immediate fallback; policy invalidation (shift, expired calibration) yields `uncalibrated` labeling, increased review/abstention, or a new qualification.

## Constraints
Runtime adaptation follows offline replay → shadow → canary → explicit default, at most one controller per subsystem — and the initial policy is BEFORE that ladder: a static table only. Loss-table declaration is data, versioned and diffable. Policy artifacts name population assumptions, validity/expiry conditions, shift indicators. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Policy determinism fixture: same signals + same policy version → same action, replayable.
- Cost-accounting fixture: a policy that triggers retries shows the full retry cost in receipts/metrics (structural witnesses count each additional forward — a target invocation is 2 loop passes / 44 layer executions per position, so hidden retries are visible in OPERATION_COSTS witnesses).
- Selection-bias guard: attempted use of spill corrections to update an accepted-population claim is rejected with a typed error naming AA-A1 as the only authority.

## Tests
- Unit: policy table parsing/versioning; loss-table validation; signal→action lookup incl. boundary signals.
- Property: policy is a pure function of (signals, policy version); no code path mutates a policy at runtime.
- E2E: run a calibrated toy task under a policy exercising all five actions; verify accepted results carry authorizing signals, spilled items export to the named local suite, and cost accounting matches structural witnesses; detailed logging of every routing decision. Model-gated runs SKIPPED_NO_MODEL.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Depends on [P5] AA-U1 calibration: policies may consume only task-valid calibrated signals.
- Depends on [P5] eval/calibrate/qualify: policy fitting/validation runs through the user-owned Assay surfaces and their split discipline.

title: [P5] Run extract --verify-semantic promotion experiment
description:
## Background
`extract --verify-semantic` re-reads extracted fields with the same wedge model (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; final RMSNorm after each pass; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; untied lm_head; SwiGLU 10752) via the judge faithfulness task. A second pass of the SAME model is correlated evidence, never independent proof — so this is an experiment with a promotion gate, off by default.

## Contract
- **Mechanism:** versioned claim templates render each extracted field (or field group) into a claim; the claim + source run through the §7.6 judge faithfulness task (`{entailed | contradicted | unsupported}` + evidence spans). The exact versioned judge task is reused — no bespoke second-reader prompt.
- **Provenance honesty:** the receipt visibly carries (a) same-model correlation (this is the same weights judging its own output) and (b) the per-field claim rendering used. A same-model correlated second read is NEVER a certificate; results feed diagnostics/DecisionPolicy inputs only.
- **Promotion gate, per extraction domain:** a per-domain locked evaluation measures incremental error-catching value (errors caught that the base path accepted) versus false alarms and cost (each verification is additional full-model work — counted in structural witnesses). Promotion happens per task/domain only when incremental value justifies false-alarm and cost rows; otherwise the flag REMAINS OFF by default.
- **Default:** off. Enabling is explicit; promoted domains may document recommended use, but the flag never silently flips on.

## Constraints
Doctrine: a second model pass is not independent proof; same-model verification stays off until it shows incremental locked-eval value and always reports correlated provenance. Claim templates are versioned data with hashes (changing one is a diffable event + eval re-run). All verification cost counts (no hidden work; OPERATION_COSTS witnesses include verification forwards). Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Phase-5 exit contribution: semantic verification is either PROMOTED per task/domain with incremental-error/cost evidence, or remains off — both are recorded outcomes.
- Per-domain locked-eval table: errors caught / false alarms / added cost (p50/p95 latency + structural forwards) per domain, against labeled fields.
- Receipt fixture: same-model provenance + claim-template hash always present when the flag ran.

## Tests
- Unit: claim-template rendering per field type; four-state result plumbing (entailed/contradicted/unsupported/no-result).
- Property: verification never mutates the base extraction result; disabling the flag is byte-identical to never having the feature for the same seed/profile.
- E2E: extraction corpus with planted errors — measure catch/false-alarm rows; detailed logging of claim renderings, verdicts, spans, and cost counters. Model-gated runs SKIPPED_NO_MODEL.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Depends on [P5] AA-U1 calibration: verification verdicts enter decision-making only as calibrated/diagnostic signals; the promotion evaluation runs on the calibration framework's locked splits.
- wants A_TASKCORE: reuses the extract task surface and the versioned judge faithfulness task from the task core.

title: [P5] Open public TaskIR recipe compiler behind equivalence and security gates
description:
## Background
Built-in tasks for the wedge model (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; final RMSNorm after each pass; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; untied lm_head; SwiGLU 10752) compile through an internal TaskIR. This bead decides whether a PUBLIC, data-only recipe format (`fnlp recipe check/explain/sample/run`) opens — and keeps it closed if its gates fail. Task extensibility is data-only and bounded; the closed outcome is acceptable.

## Contract
- **Public format = a frozen, data-only SUBSET of internal TaskIR:** typed segments (with trust provenance), decode strategies, budgets, source constraints, finite postconditions, and a NON-WEAKENABLE dependency scope (a recipe cannot claim ItemLocal for work that is PartitionReduce/CorpusGlobal).
- **Never:** code execution, tool execution, network access, reads of undeclared files, scripting-language interpretation (no Jinja, no shell, no WASM), unconstrained retries, or bypass of budgets/provenance/calibration.
- **Unknown keys forward-reject:** an unrecognized key is a compile error, never silently ignored (no "forward-compatible" acceptance of unvalidated semantics).
- **Surfaces:** `recipe check` (compile/resource-check without model load), `explain` (human-readable compiled plan), `sample` (walk the supported grammar for DX/fuzz reuse), `run`.
- **Opening gate:** the public surface opens ONLY after (a) built-in equivalence — recipes reproducing built-in tasks byte-match those built-ins under the same profile; (b) resource-bound enforcement — every declared budget provably caps the run; (c) security gates — no-code/no-network properties, trust-segment preservation, unknown-key rejection all green. If any gate fails, the format STAYS INTERNAL — a recorded, legitimate outcome, not a failure to deliver.

## Constraints
Doctrine #20 (task extensibility data-only and bounded) verbatim-binding. G8: recipe outputs validate or typed no-result. Every parser boundary rejects duplicate JSON object keys. Presets are data; prompts versioned with hashes. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon. Recipe compile errors are exit 8.

## Evidence / gates
- Built-in equivalence suite: each shipped built-in re-expressed as a public recipe produces identical output under a fixed profile/seed (or the surface stays closed).
- Security property suite: fuzzed recipes never reach network/file/exec observability points (capability rows make no-network/no-spawn compile-time properties); trust-segment preservation fixtures; unknown-key/duplicate-key negative fixtures.
- §9.6 public-recipe rows: built-in equivalence, resource-bound enforcement, unknown-key rejection, trust-segment preservation, no-code/no-network properties.
- The open/closed decision is recorded with evidence either way (Phase-5 exit: "public TaskIR recipes either pass all gates or remain internal").

## Tests
- Unit: subset schema validation; dependency-scope non-weakening checker; explain output stability.
- Property/fuzz: arbitrary recipe bytes → compile-or-clean-error (exit 8), never dead/unbounded state, never executable behavior; budget declarations always enforced at runtime.
- E2E: run an equivalence recipe against its built-in and byte-compare; detailed logging of compile decisions, budget charges, and rejection reasons. Model-gated runs SKIPPED_NO_MODEL.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Intra-epic independent (internal TaskIR exists from Phase 4); epic rollup only.

title: [P5] Execute gated AA spikes: C1 cache, B1 blocking, L1 radix, N1 prefetch
description:
## Background
Four alien-artifact cards remain for Phase 5 as GATED SPIKES against the wedge model (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; final RMSNorm after each pass; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144 — logits f32 664,576 B; untied lm_head; SwiGLU 10752). Each enters implementation only on its own evidence gate; a negative result recorded in the graveyard ledger is a SUCCESS outcome.

## Contract
- **AA-C1 scan-resistant prefix/grammar cache (S3-FIFO):** eligible ONLY after replayed LRU key traces show one-hit scan pollution. Loss = miss cost + cache bytes + p99 lock time. Requires replayed key trace, hit/byte-hit/eviction/lock metrics, privacy-namespace proof (no cross-user reuse; eviction traces reveal no document substrings), and a workload-shift test. Never added because the algorithm is fashionable. Fallback: byte-bounded deterministic LRU.
- **AA-B1 MinHash/LSH resolve blocking:** deterministic seeded MinHash/LSH candidate union, gated on pair-candidate RECALL versus exhaustive type-compatible pairs on locked labeled corpora (every avoided pair saves a complete two-loop invocation; a missed pair can corrupt a cluster). Hash/seed/banding parameters live in recipe/receipt; snapshot/order invariance required; promotion is task-quality-gated, not model-parity-gated. Fallback: exhaustive type-compatible pairs or the proven lexical blocker.
- **AA-L1 exact radix/logit ordering:** bounded radix/bucket passes over canonical f32 order for the full 166,144 validated finite logits + top-k/top-p. DIFFERENTIAL-EXACT vs the stable full-sort/selection baseline: same candidate order and distribution; adversarial fixtures cover signs, subnormals, infinities rejected at the boundary, equal-logit/token-id ties, p near 0/1, boundary buckets. Exponent buckets alone cannot approximate nucleus mass or skip required normalization. Fallback: stable full sort/selection (§6.10).
- **AA-N1 cache-pollution-resistant M=1 weight streaming/prefetch:** architecturally VALID mechanisms only — prefetch hints are hints, not promises; x86 write-back memory is NOT relabeled "non-temporal"; streaming-load instructions whose contract does not apply to ordinary WB model pages are INELIGIBLE. Eligibility is M=1 or a measured no-reuse regime, never all GEMM. Counter-backed paired A/B proves values/accumulation unchanged and measures KV/activation/cache effects through BOTH loops; dispatch key includes M/shape/host profile; thermal + multi-client interference tests; evidence names the exact instruction/hint, memory type, architectural contract, and counter interpretation. Fallback: ordinary cached loads.
- **Every card:** EV = (Impact×Confidence×Reuse)/(Effort×AdoptionFriction) ≥ 2 to enter (integer factors 1–5 with one-sentence evidence each); fixed profile/search budget declared before execution — exhaustion means no promotion; negative results recorded in docs/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE.md (the graveyard ledger, losers reverted with NO source landed); evidence dir carries env.json, manifest.json, repro.lock, and LEGAL.md when external IP/papers informed the work, with primary-source review status recorded.

## Constraints
Profile-first: a card enters only when a measured hotspot maps to it (no hotspot → no change). One card, one causal change, one ledger entry. Keep-gate: confidence interval AND practical threshold both win or the baseline is restored. Integer SIMD ≡ scalar/i64 where applicable; measured-faster wins; deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
Per card: entry-gate record (trace/EV), differential/exactness proof appropriate to the card, randomized paired A/B distributions (p50/p95/p99, energy where available), and a keep or graveyard disposition with rollback (dispatch-table entry or config). Ledger rows in PERF_LEDGER/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE.

## Tests
- AA-C1: cache simulator replay on recorded traces; privacy-namespace property tests.
- AA-B1: recall-vs-exhaustive differential on locked corpora; seed/banding determinism; order-invariance property.
- AA-L1: exhaustive small-vocab differential + adversarial float fixtures; sampled-stream exactness under fixed seeds.
- AA-N1: value-exactness differential (bit-identical outputs); counter capture harness with documented interpretation.
- All: detailed logging (trace ids, seeds, counters, EV worksheets); model-gated rows SKIPPED_NO_MODEL.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Intra-epic independent: each card gates on its own trace/EV evidence, not on other P5 beads; epic rollup only.

title: [P6] Freeze CLI/robot contract with goldens; no success-shaped stubs
description:
## Background
Phase 6 hardens the product around the one-model wedge (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; final RMSNorm after each pass; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; untied lm_head; SwiGLU 10752; RoPE θ=7e7 split-half). Agents are the primary consumers of `fnlp`; a frozen, golden-backed CLI/robot contract is what makes every later claim testable and every downstream integration stable.

## Contract
- **Goldens** (per /testing-golden-artifacts; UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 with mandatory diff review):
  - CLI help for every subcommand (human surface);
  - `robot schema` output — the frozen JSON-schema fixture that a contract test validates every emitted NDJSON event against (schema_version on every line: run_start, stage, doc, doc_error, token, flush, run_complete, run_error; request_seq echo semantics);
  - exit codes, documented in error.rs: 0 ok · 1 generic · 2 usage · 3 model not found · 4 input decode/parse · 5 budget/timeout · 6 cancelled · 7 artifact integrity/format/version mismatch · 8 schema/recipe compile · 9 admission/resource limit · 10 structured task no-result. Calibrated abstention = exit 0 + status "abstained", NOT 10.
  - CancelKind → exit mapping frozen: Timeout/Deadline/PollQuota/CostBudget→5; User/Shutdown/ordinary ParentCancelled→6; ResourceUnavailable→9; FailFast/LinkedExit→underlying typed error else 1; RaceLost escaping as a root terminal result is an invariant failure (1 + crashpack). The CancelReason attribution chain is retained in the robot envelope.
- **No success-shaped stubs before their phase:** an unbuilt experimental command is ABSENT from the surface, or returns a versioned `surface_not_built` error ONLY where the frozen robot schema explicitly describes that state. Never a stub that exits 0.
- Conventions frozen: stdout data / stderr diagnostics; bare `fnlp` prints help (never a TUI); NO_COLOR, CI, TERM=dumb honored; `--json` on every task; canonical JSON (recursive UTF-8-byte key order, pinned number/string escaping, non-finite floats rejected).

## Constraints
Robot mode: stable versioned schema, deterministic where possible, line-oriented NDJSON, no human decoration mixed into machine output. The library never reads env vars behind its caller's back (FNLP_* snapshotted once into NlpEngineBuilder). Two binaries (fnlp + franken_nlp) from one `cli_main()`, thin shims in separate files. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Golden suite green across all subcommands; frozen-schema contract test green; surface_not_built negative fixtures for every gated/experimental command (recipe pre-gate, --tools pre-OQ-10, resident, audit, partition/merge as applicable).
- FEATURE_PARITY.md SurfaceMatrix rows (present|partial|missing|n/a; partial never rounds up) generated from the frozen surface.

## Tests
- Golden: help/schema/exit-code fixtures; diff review required to update.
- Property: every emitted robot event validates against the frozen schema; every documented exit path reachable by a fixture; no undocumented exit code observable.
- E2E: pipe-based agent-usage smoke (NDJSON in/out, exit-code checks, NO_COLOR/TERM=dumb behavior) with detailed logging; model-gated paths report SKIPPED_NO_MODEL.

## Dependencies & rationale
- wants A_DAEMON: the batch daemon's hardened event/ordering semantics are part of the surface being frozen.
- wants A_TASKCORE: the task envelopes/exit semantics being frozen come from the task core.

title: [P6] Ship fnlp doctor: idempotent self-check and repair
description:
## Background
`fnlp doctor` is the idempotent self-check/repair surface for installations of the one-model wedge (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; SwiGLU 10752). A 4+ GB artifact cache with staged/derived packings accumulates real-world damage — interrupted pulls, permission drift, orphaned staging — and agents need one command that diagnoses and safely repairs it.

## Contract
- **Checks (read-only diagnosis first):** artifact resolution (installed artifacts discoverable, digests consistent with the manifest/catalog), format versions (.fnlpq container versions supported; version mismatch reported as exit 7 class findings), cache permissions (owner-only where required), orphan staging detection (leftover `create_new` staging entries from interrupted operations).
- **Repairs (idempotent, safe):** orphan staging is QUARANTINED — moved aside under a named quarantine location, never deleted (file deletion requires express permission; doctor has none); permissions corrected toward the owner-only policy; broken derived packings re-derivable state reported (re-derivation delegated to `fnlp models derive`, not silently performed unless asked).
- **Idempotency:** running doctor twice yields the same end state and a clean second report; every repair is reported (before/after) and reversible where the platform allows.
- **Modes:** default = check + report; explicit repair flag applies fixes; robot NDJSON output under the frozen schema; exit codes per the frozen contract (findings do not fake success).

## Constraints
Doctor never touches the network (no pull; it may recommend `fnlp pull`). Never deletes files — quarantine only. Owner-controlled roots, no symlink/reparse/device traversal during checks (hostile-root discipline from §8.6). One artifact manager owns model content: doctor inspects and quarantines, it does not re-download or reassemble parts. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Fixture matrix of damaged installations (missing part, bad perms, orphan staging, stale format version, torn activation leftovers) each mapping to a deterministic finding + repair disposition.
- Idempotency proof: doctor → doctor produces identical second report (golden).
- Robot-schema coverage for doctor events in the frozen contract.

## Tests
- Unit: each check's detection logic on synthetic roots; quarantine naming/collision behavior.
- Property: doctor with repairs enabled never leaves the root in a worse state (all mutations staged/reported; quarantine preserves bytes); no deletion syscall paths exist.
- E2E: build a damaged fake root, run check → repair → recheck clean, with detailed logging of every finding and mutation; hostile-root cases (symlinked cache dir, device file in staging) refuse safely. Model-gated verification steps report SKIPPED_NO_MODEL. Named runnable `scripts/e2e_doctor_damaged_roots.sh`: builds each damaged-root fixture, runs check → repair → recheck, one machine-parseable row per finding (finding id, disposition, before/after state, idempotency verdict, exit code); hostile-root refusals logged with reason.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Depends on [P6] CLI/robot contract freeze: doctor's events, findings, and exit semantics must land inside the frozen schema, not beside it.

title: [P6] Ship fnlp tune: bit-identical selection with validity-domain profiles
description:
## Background
`fnlp tune` selects per-install execution choices for the one-model wedge (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; SwiGLU 10752). Doctrine #24: local tuning retains shipped defaults unless evidence is durable — tune is a narrow selector among already-proved options, never a new numerics or scheduling authority.

## Contract
- **Selection domain:** ONLY already-proved bit-identical fixed-shape kernel choices (dispatch alternatives whose outputs are exactly equal for the same artifact recipe/profile) plus conservative thread caps. Tune may NEVER select a path that changes bytes/tokens, and CANNOT reference packing representations that are not installed.
- **Profile keying (validity domain):** profiles are keyed by binary/kernel ABI + artifact recipe + CPU/ISA + OS feature exposure + topology + workload validity domain. Stale or mismatched profiles are IGNORED (shipped defaults remain); transient batch/page-cache/NUMA observations are not machine constants.
- **Measurement:** repeated randomized A/B trials post-warmup through thermal steady state; a selection is kept only when the confidence interval lies WHOLLY beyond the practical minimum improvement AND hysteresis prevents flapping between near-equal choices.
- **Objective:** includes decode/prefill time AND disk bytes, mapped bytes, and load time (R0 startup is a first-class regime — for a 4+ GB artifact, load/hash/page-fault behavior can dominate one-shot CLI usage).
- **Modes:** `--quick` (bounded trial budget) and `--full`; both write a validity-domain-keyed profile; `fnlp` at runtime verifies the key before applying, else uses shipped defaults.

## Constraints
Doctrine #24 verbatim-binding; measured-faster wins but hardware capability is not a routing decision; forced paths remain for proof runs. No new unsafe islands; no direct topology probing outside the ratified safe FrankenSuite surface (or the feature stays off). Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon. Benchmark harness is repository-owned (std/suite surfaces only).

## Evidence / gates
- Bit-identity precondition proof: the candidate set enumerates only dispatch entries with existing exactness certificates (scalar/i64 differential or byte-identity fixtures); a candidate without a certificate cannot enter the trial.
- A/B methodology fixture: randomized order, warmup, steady-state detection, CI + practical-threshold + hysteresis all recorded in the profile.
- Stale-profile behavior: mismatch on ANY key field → ignored profile + shipped defaults, proven by fixture.

## Tests
- Unit: profile key derivation/serialization; hysteresis logic; candidate-set filtering against the certificate registry.
- Property: applying any tune profile never changes semantic output (differential over a frozen prefix per selected vs default path); uninstalled-packing references rejected.
- E2E (model-gated, SKIPPED_NO_MODEL): tune --quick on a real artifact, verify profile written, applied, and ignored after a simulated ABI/recipe change; detailed logging of trials (per-trial times, CI computation, decision rationale). Named runnable `scripts/e2e_tune_profile_cycle.sh`: tune --quick → profile written → applied → invalidated by simulated ABI/recipe change → shipped defaults restored, one machine-parseable row per phase (profile key fields, decision, trial stats), SKIPPED_NO_MODEL explicit.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Depends on [P6] CLI/robot contract freeze: tune's surface/report lands inside the frozen contract.
- wants A_DISPATCH: tune selects among the measured dispatch table's proven entries; that table and its certificates must exist first.

title: [P6] Write install.sh and install.ps1 with verify-before-install
description:
## Background
`install.sh` (Unix) and `install.ps1` (Windows) are the client installers for fnlp and its one-model wedge (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; artifact chunks are exactly 1,957,046,720 bytes except the tail, ≤64 parts). Doctrine #28/#29: source acquisition, release packaging, and client installation are different trust zones, and ONE artifact manager (the installed binary's `fnlp pull`) owns every model download.

## Contract
- **Channel:** installers fetch from IMMUTABLE release tags only — never curl|sh from `main`, never a mutable branch URL.
- **Verify BEFORE install:** binary digest AND provenance attestation are verified before the binary is placed; verification failure aborts with the failure surfaced (checksum vs attestation status reported separately — SHA-256 proves byte identity, not publisher identity).
- **Interactive policy:** a y/N prompt shows model version, quant recipe, download bytes, and required peak free bytes before any model download; `--with-model` (non-interactive opt-in) and `--no-pull` (binary only) flags.
- **Model handoff:** the installer invokes the exact installed binary by ABSOLUTE path — `"<install-dir>/fnlp" pull ...`. Shell/PowerShell NEVER parse the model manifest, concatenate parts, invent cache filenames, or duplicate integrity logic.
- **Failure isolation:** a pull failure NEVER rolls back the verified binary install; the binary remains usable and the summary says exactly how to retry.
- **Final summary:** prints the retry command (`fnlp pull ...`), the cache path, and uninstall instructions.

## Constraints
Per /installer-workmanship: set -euo pipefail discipline, no partial-state on interrupt (staged + atomic placement), honest error text. Default pull trusts only the release-bound embedded manifest; local/private manifests require an expected digest via an independently trusted channel. Never upload/overwrite release assets (installers are read-only consumers). Windows installer is PowerShell-native (no WSL assumption). Installers honor CI/non-TTY (prompt becomes explicit flag requirement, never a silent yes).

## Evidence / gates
- Fresh-HOME (Unix) and fresh-LOCALAPPDATA (Windows) fake-release E2E: install → verify → prompt policy → `--with-model` pull delegation → summary; pull-failure case leaves the binary installed and prints retry.
- Negative fixtures: tampered binary digest, missing/invalid attestation, mutable-ref URL — all abort before install.
- Shellcheck/PSScriptAnalyzer clean; byte-level review that no manifest parsing/concatenation exists in either script.

## Tests
- Unit-level script tests: flag parsing (--with-model/--no-pull), prompt gating under non-TTY, absolute-path delegation string.
- E2E in scratch HOME/LOCALAPPDATA with a local fake release server: full matrix (accept/decline prompt, no-pull, pull failure, retry) with detailed transcript logging retained as fixtures. The matrix ships as named runnables `scripts/e2e_installer_fresh_home.sh` (scratch HOME) and `scripts/e2e_installer_fresh_home.ps1` (scratch LOCALAPPDATA): accept/decline, --with-model, --no-pull, tampered digest, missing attestation, and pull-failure-then-retry cases, one machine-parseable row per case (case id, checksum verdict and attestation verdict reported separately, exit code).
- Model-gated real-release runs report SKIPPED_NO_MODEL in ordinary CI; the armed release-certification run exercises the real path.

## Dependencies & rationale
- wants A_PULL: `fnlp pull` (streamed verification, reassembly, atomic activation) is the one artifact manager the installers delegate to; its contract must exist first.

title: [P6] Publish GitHub artifact attestations for five subjects with offline verify
description:
## Background
SHA-256 proves byte identity, not publisher identity. Releases of fnlp and its model artifacts (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; chunks exactly 1,957,046,720 bytes except tail) therefore publish GitHub artifact attestations binding provenance to every distributable subject — and provenance status is always displayed separately from checksum status, never collapsed into one "verified" boolean.

## Contract
- **Five attestation subjects:**
  1. every platform binary (all 5 dist targets);
  2. the binary SBOM;
  3. the canonical model manifest (release-bound);
  4. the conversion/packaging receipts (the receipt closure proving pinned source → canonical Generic → chunks);
  5. the `.fnlpq` artifact — as a whole-file subject digest, or as parts + reconstruction digest where the whole file is impractical to attest directly.
- **Verification UX:** documented `gh attestation verify` instructions per subject class (exact commands, expected identities); `fnlp licenses`/`provenance` surfaces report binary/manifest/artifact provenance states SEPARATELY.
- **Offline verification:** an offline attestation bundle is produced and verified in a NETWORK-DENIED test — a machine with no egress can still validate provenance from the bundle.
- **Separation invariant:** checksums (digest match) and provenance (attestation) are distinct reported states everywhere (pull output, provenance command, docs); a missing attestation downgrades provenance status without invalidating digest status, and vice versa.

## Constraints
Immutable release/tag channel; never rewrite bytes under an existing tag/name; no wildcard/`--clobber` uploads. Private expected digests require an independently trusted channel. Attestation generation runs in release CI (per /gh-actions patterns); the runtime product itself never requires network to run inference. Deps unchanged (clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite).

## Evidence / gates
- Release-candidate run producing all five subject attestations; `gh attestation verify` transcript per subject archived.
- Network-denied offline-bundle verification test green (firewalled job or unshare/network-off harness).
- Negative fixtures: tampered subject → verify fails; attestation for a different subject digest → refused; provenance/checksum status shown separately in `fnlp provenance` output goldens.

## Tests
- Unit: subject-digest computation for parts+reconstruction form; provenance state enumeration in the provenance report.
- E2E: fake-release pipeline emits attestations, verifies online and via offline bundle in a network-denied environment; detailed logging of subject digests, verifier output, and status classification.
- Ordinary CI without release credentials reports the attestation e2e as explicitly skipped (typed skip, no counterfeit pass).

## Dependencies & rationale
- Depends on [P6] installers: the installer's verify-before-install step consumes these attestations and their documented verification flow; subjects/UX must be designed together.

title: [P6] Build 5-target dist matrix with portable baselines and runtime dispatch
description:
## Background
fnlp ships as portable binaries running the one-model wedge (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; SwiGLU 10752) on hosts we cannot inspect. Portability is a G4 goal: portable baselines with runtime dispatch — width/ISA decided at run time by measurement and capability detection, never baked in at compile time.

## Contract
- **Five targets:** linux x86-64, linux arm64, darwin x86-64, darwin arm64, windows-msvc.
- **Recorded minimums:** minimum glibc (linux), minimum macOS, minimum Windows versions are measured, recorded, and published per target (the minimum-OS/ABI matrix).
- **Portable baselines + runtime dispatch:** binaries compile to portable baseline features per target and select SIMD tiers (AVX2 / AVX-512-VNNI zmm+ymm / NEON/SDOT / SMMLA only when the OS advertises FEAT_I8MM / scalar) at runtime via the capability census; `target-cpu=native` is FORBIDDEN in release builds.
- **Build+smoke:** every target builds from the exact dated nightly (rust-toolchain.toml) and passes a smoke run (help, robot schema, selftest without model); `rustc -Vv`/LLVM/target recorded in CI per build.
- Forced-ISA runs execute selftest first and fail typed on absent capability (never SIGILL as UX).

## Constraints
Nightly toolchain required (stdarch i8mm/dotprod intrinsics, portable_simd); floating nightly drift is a plan-revision event — the exact dated nightly is pinned. unsafe only in enumerated SIMD/mmap islands (deny not forbid; policy scan enforces the island list). No Rayon in the release graph; deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite. Firmware/VM feature exposure is authoritative for dispatch (AVX-512 width is not destiny — measured selection, not assumed widest).

## Evidence / gates
- CI matrix: 5/5 targets build + smoke green; per-target toolchain/LLVM/ABI records archived.
- Minimum-OS matrix validated on the oldest supported images (or documented as the tested floor).
- Dispatch proof: on each target class, the capability census selects only advertised tiers; forced-ISA negative test (request AVX-512 on non-AVX-512 host → typed failure after selftest).
- G3/G4 success-metric row: five target binaries build/smoke; inference opens no network and needs no foreign ML runtime/GPU.

## Tests
- Unit: capability-census parsing per platform; dispatch-table tier selection under mocked capability rows.
- Smoke per target in CI: `fnlp --version` (attribution line), `robot schema`, `robot selftest` (scalar tiers without model), exit codes.
- E2E (model-gated per platform, SKIPPED_NO_MODEL otherwise): frozen-prefix inference identical across targets for the same artifact/profile where the recipe claims cross-target identity; detailed logging of detected features, chosen tiers, and OS minimums.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Scaffold bead (franken_nlp-uxw): the CI matrix builds the crate/toolchain skeleton (rust-toolchain.toml pinned dated nightly, module tree, check entrypoints) created there.
- Streaming pull (franken_nlp-g9y): the model-gated per-platform e2e obtains its artifact through `fnlp pull` verified streaming on each target; without it only the no-model smoke tier can run.
- No new semantics of its own: the dist matrix packages already-proven kernels/dispatch — everything else it exercises arrives via the epic's other members.

title: [P6] Close claims/behavior/discrepancy/perf/parity/cost/receipt registries
description:
## Background
The registries make proof state machine-checkable for the one-model wedge (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; SwiGLU 10752). Release requires every registry green with cross-reference validators — prose can no longer outrun evidence.

## Contract
Close ALL of:
- **docs/CLAIMS.json:** every benchmark/quality/portability/security/determinism/artifact claim has id, exact wording scope, state (targeted|observed|evidenced|withdrawn), validity domain, evidence artifact digests, expiry/revalidation trigger, allowed public surfaces. CI extracts claim ids from README/help/release templates and REJECTS wording stronger than registry state; public numeric/superlative claims must carry an explicit claim id.
- **docs/BEHAVIOR_NOTES.md:** intentional reference divergences/upstream defects with source pin, minimized fixture, decision, compatibility impact, expiry. Seed entry BN-GEN-DEFAULT-001: upstream generation_config.json defaults to sampling (temperature=.6, top_k=20, top_p=.95) while fnlp defaults to greedy and requires explicit `--sample --preset nanbeige`; help/receipts/fixtures expose the choice.
- **docs/DISCREPANCIES.md:** every accepted numeric divergence with reference behavior, ours, measured impact, validity envelope, REAL rollback authority (kernel/profile selector or prior immutable-artifact activation — no env var claiming to restore absent bf16 weights), review date.
- **docs/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE.md + docs/PERF_LEDGER.md:** artifact-graph format (claim_id, evidence, fixture hashes, CPU feature string, exact command+env, disposition); losers reverted with no source landed; slower rows retained.
- **docs/FEATURE_PARITY.md:** FeatureUniverse/SurfaceMatrix — every subcommand, robot event, exit code, env var, task, preset as present|partial|missing|n/a; partial never rounds up.
- **docs/OPERATION_COSTS.json:** structural witnesses — invocation kind, loop passes, physical-layer executions, token positions, lm_head rows, candidate-trie nodes, KV logical/committed bytes, source-automaton transitions, cache hits by dependency scope, generated tokens. `target_full` = exactly 2 loop passes and 44 physical-layer executions per token position; AA-D1's `draft_loop1` counted separately, never mislabeled.
- **.fnlpr receipts:** schema-versioned; grades Replayable / StructuralReplay / VerifiableIfArtifactsSupplied / AuditOnly; exported receipts never expose raw SHA-256 of private/low-entropy content; "verified receipt" without a grade is forbidden.
- Each registry: canonical schema, version migration policy (no compat shims pre-1.0), cross-reference validator, frozen negative fixtures. README/help wording ≤ registry state everywhere.

## Constraints
Honest, measured everything (doctrine #11); claims and receipts are typed evidence (doctrine #30). Registries complement, never replace, L0–L5/scorecards/hostile tests/human review. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite.

## Evidence / gates
- Cross-reference validators green over the full registry set; negative fixtures (overclaiming README line, grade-less receipt, draft_loop1 mislabeled target_full, partial rounded up) all rejected.
- CI wiring: claim-id extraction gate active on README/help/release templates.
- Gauntlet pillar (c) consumes FEATURE_PARITY; pillar gates reference CLAIMS states.

## Tests
- Unit: schema validation per registry; migration-policy enforcement (regeneration, not shims).
- Property: every public numeric/superlative string in README/help maps to a claim id whose state permits that surface; every receipt has exactly one grade.
- E2E: full validator run over the real registries with detailed logging of every cross-reference edge checked; seeded corruption fixtures fail loudly.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Depends on [P6] CLI/robot contract freeze: FEATURE_PARITY and claim extraction need the frozen surface as ground truth.
- wants A_CAL: calibration/qualification validity semantics (validity dates, scoped coverage claims) must exist for CLAIMS/receipt rows that reference them.

title: [P6] Run three-pillar gauntlet to convergence
description:
## Background
The three-pillar gauntlet is release certification for the one-model wedge (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; final RMSNorm after each pass; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; untied lm_head; SwiGLU 10752). Parity gate FIRST, perf second; the gauntlet runs to convergence, not to a demo.

## Contract
- **Pillar (a) Performance:** per-stage/per-regime (R0 cold/warm startup, R1 latency decode, R2 corpus scoring, R3 corpus generation, R4 long-context) distributions with fair baselines: tested post-support official llama.cpp revision in explicit CPU-only configuration (exact build flags, commit, GGUF recipe, mmap mode, threads/affinity, prompt/template bytes recorded), thread/allocator/precision/prompt/output parity; nearest-format peers (our int8 vs Q8_0 class) plus matched-footprint and matched-quality views — never "matched quantization"; randomized paired A/B post-warmup/thermal-stabilization; distributions and confidence intervals, never best-of-N; slower rows stay published.
- **Pillar (b) Conformance:** L0–L5 ladder, property/fuzz suites, task evals — all green under their named profiles/tolerances.
- **Pillar (c) Surface parity:** FeatureUniverse/SurfaceMatrix complete; partial never rounds up.
- **Convergence:** every hard gate green AND ≥2 consecutive clean FULL runs after the last load-bearing change; the implementation gauntlet targets ≥10 adversarial convergence rounds (distinct from the ≥4 independent plan-review rounds).
- **Scheduler/cancellation proofs:** deterministic asupersync Lab runs with oracle suites (quiescence, obligation-leak, loser-drain, cancellation protocol), bounded DPOR-style guided schedule exploration (coverage published as run/class/budget/saturation — never "exhaustive" by adjective), seed-bound chaos for the async state; PLUS the repository's bounded native team-state model and hostile stress/replay for the scoped_cpu OS-thread half. Crashpacks retained for every failure.
- **TLC discipline:** Lab TLA+ exports are TLC INPUTS only; a bounded-model-check claim requires retained TLC version, config, command, result, checked-property scope, and counterexample when one exists.
- Statistical task metrics: preregistered point estimates + confidence intervals on locked data; no "Beta-posterior × conformal" aggregate; no statistical process standing in for a proof.

## Constraints
Fairness controls mandatory (thread/allocator/precision); load-bearing deterministic claims use the right authority (checked arithmetic/formal bounds for accumulators/capacity; exhaustive/property differential for SIMD). G1>G2. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; builds via rch where heavy.

## Evidence / gates
- Gauntlet run manifest per round: code/artifact SHAs, host fingerprints, seeds, full pillar results; ≥2 consecutive clean runs archived; round count toward the ≥10 target logged.
- Crashpack ledger for every failing interleaving with replay commands; TLC evidence bundles where model-check claims are made.
- Release-blocking wiring: any pillar red blocks certification.

## Tests
This bead's deliverable IS the executed campaign plus its harness meta-tests: harness determinism (same seeds → same schedule exploration), fairness-control verification (allocator/thread parity actually applied to baselines), report-schema goldens, and detailed per-round logging. Model-gated rows report SKIPPED_NO_MODEL in ordinary CI; certification requires the armed pass.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Depends on [P6] registry closure: pillar (c) and claim gating consume closed registries; certification against open registries is meaningless.
- wants A_EVALFW: pillar (b) task evals run on the eval framework's locked datasets/scorecards.

title: [P6] Certify fresh-machine release e2e with offline replay
description:
## Background
Release certification must prove the CLIENT path end-to-end for the one-model wedge (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; ten-file conversion closure 8,360,887,509 bytes upstream; release chunks exactly 1,957,046,720 bytes except tail): a fresh machine with nothing installed reaches real inference, and reaches it AGAIN offline from cache, byte-perfectly.

## Contract
The certified sequence, on fresh HOME (Unix) and fresh LOCALAPPDATA (Windows):
1. **Installer** (install.sh/install.ps1) → binary verified (digest + provenance attestation) and placed;
2. **`fnlp pull`** via the installed binary → streamed part/whole verification, reassembly, native packing, atomic activation;
3. **No-flag discovery** → a bare task invocation finds the installed artifact with zero flags (installed-basename discovery);
4. **Frozen real inference** → a pinned prompt produces the frozen expected output under the named profile;
5. **Offline second run** → with network denied, the same invocation reproduces a BYTE-PERFECT cache hit and opens NO network connection.
Additional certifications:
- **Remote inventory re-download identity:** re-downloading the published parts reproduces the exact inventory digests (remote replay of the packaging receipts);
- **Clean-cache replay:** wiping the cache and re-pulling converges to identical artifact digests and identical inference bytes.
- Ordinary CI reports SKIPPED_NO_MODEL; the armed certification records artifact digest and proof the native path ran (all fallback locations pointed at /nonexistent).

## Constraints
The public model-asset release gate (Testing Policy): fresh-HOME installer → pull → no-flag inference, then byte-perfect cache hit whose inference run opens no network. One artifact manager owns downloads (installer delegates; no script-side manifest logic). Never clobber immutable release assets. Network denial is real (denied egress), not a mocked client. Deps unchanged; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Certification transcript per platform: installer output, pull verification lines (per-part digests), discovery resolution, inference output hash, offline-run network audit (zero connections observed), cache-hit byte identity.
- Remote inventory re-download receipt matching the packaging receipts; clean-cache replay receipt.
- G5/G6/G7 success-metric row satisfied: the release path proves deterministic split → attested manifest/receipt closure → remote re-download → fresh-machine install → pull → no-flag discovery → identical semantic inference with offline second run.

## Tests
- Harness: scratch-HOME/LOCALAPPDATA isolation; egress-denial wrapper (firewall/namespace) with positive control (a canary connection attempt is detected and fails);
- E2E matrix: accept-model install, --no-pull + later pull, pull interruption + resume, cache-hit verification; detailed logging of every digest compared and every network decision. The certified sequence ships as the named runnable `scripts/e2e_release_fresh_machine.sh`: executes steps 1–5 plus clean-cache replay under the egress-denial wrapper, logging every digest compared, every network decision (incl. the positive-control canary), one machine-parseable row per step (step id, digest verdict, network verdict, exit code); unarmed CI prints SKIPPED_NO_MODEL rows explicitly.
- Failure fixtures: tampered part → pull refuses; missing attestation → installer refuses; discovery with empty cache → typed exit 3 (model not found).

## Dependencies & rationale
- Depends on [P6] installers: the certified path starts at install.sh/install.ps1.
- Depends on [P6] attestations: verify-before-install and offline bundle verification are part of the certified path.
- Depends on [P6] three-pillar gauntlet: certification is only meaningful over a gauntlet-green build.
- wants A_PULL: `fnlp pull` streamed verification/reassembly/activation is the machinery under certification.

title: [P6] Run docs truth pass: reality-check, de-slopify, ergonomics audit
description:
## Background
The final docs pass keeps public prose honest about the one-model wedge (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; SwiGLU 10752). The project's rule: README/help wording never exceeds registry state, and performance numbers stay TARGETED until measured.

## Contract
- **Reality check:** README and AGENTS-facing docs audited line-by-line against docs/CLAIMS.json — every numeric/superlative public claim carries a claim id whose state (targeted|observed|evidenced) permits that surface and wording strength; anything stronger is rewritten or the claim is withdrawn. Apply /reality-check-for-project discipline: gaps between vision text and shipped behavior are enumerated and fixed in the text, not papered over.
- **De-slopify:** the house voice is preserved — factual, specific, no AI-slop tells (per /de-slopify); rewrites must not flatten the README's established style (subsystem codenames, house structure).
- **Performance honesty:** no speculative numbers promoted — the historical illustrative ceilings (e.g. ~74 tok/s M4 Pro-class bandwidth math) and any unmeasured figure remain clearly TARGETED/illustrative until a measured row exists in PERF_LEDGER; measured numbers cite host fingerprint + artifact recipe.
- **Agent-ergonomics audit of robot surfaces:** stable versioned schema confirmed self-describing; NDJSON line discipline, exit codes, stdout/stderr split, NO_COLOR/CI/TERM=dumb behavior, and pipe-friendliness reviewed against the frozen contract; findings fixed or filed (per the agent-ergonomics methodology, scored honestly).
- Attribution surfaces verified: one-line `fnlp --version` attribution, `fnlp licenses` bundle, Apache-2.0 text + Nanbeige attribution + modification notice present per §5.7.

## Constraints
Docs are bound by the CLAIMS registry (CI claim-id extraction is the enforcement backstop; this pass is the human-quality layer on top). Never introduce "license uncertainty" language — the model license is settled Apache-2.0 per the pinned card. No new claims invented during rewrite. The four governing docs are edited only through their owners' process (this bead proposes diffs; it does not bypass review).

## Evidence / gates
- Audit worksheet: every public claim line → claim id → state → verdict (ok/rewritten/withdrawn), archived with the release.
- De-slopify diff reviewed; voice-preservation check (before/after excerpts) recorded.
- Agent-ergonomics findings list with dispositions; robot-surface score recorded.
- CI claim-gate green AFTER the rewrite (proving the pass converged with the machine check).

## Tests
- The claim-id extraction CI gate re-run over the rewritten README/help/release templates.
- Golden diff review for help-text changes (UPDATE_GOLDENS=1 discipline).
- Link/whitespace/doc checks; detailed log of every claim-line disposition.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Depends on [P6] three-pillar gauntlet: the truth pass documents the certified state; writing it before convergence would document fiction.

title: [P7] Qualify document-major analyze packs per task
description:
## Background
Backlog stretch (explicitly gated; NEVER blocks v1). Document-major `analyze` packs would run several tasks over one document prefill of the wedge model (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; final RMSNorm after each pass; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; SwiGLU 10752), amortizing the expensive 44-execution prefill. But prompt ORDER can change quality on a 3B model, so eligibility is empirical per task — the typed segment ABI is adopted; "instructions-last is fine" and any speedup number are NOT.

## Contract
- **Per-task eligibility gate:** a task enters a document-major pack ONLY after (a) instructions-before vs instructions-after scorecards on its locked eval show no disqualifying quality regression, and (b) cold-prefill equivalence is proven (the pack's shared-prefill result equals the task's standalone cold-prefill result under the named profile, or the difference is a published, accepted delta).
- **No speculative speedup claims:** pack throughput/latency numbers are measured per host/regime and enter PERF_LEDGER before any public claim; the pack ships with per-task eligibility metadata (which tasks are pack-qualified, under which prompt order).
- Pack composition/order is versioned data; a task failing its gate simply stays standalone (packs degrade gracefully to sequential execution).
- Structural witnesses count shared vs per-task work honestly (shared prefill counted once; per-task suffixes attributed per task).

## Constraints
Prompt-segment order effects are QUALITY PROBES, not invariants — the model is allowed to be order-sensitive, so results are reported, never asserted mathematically. Typed prompt-segment/trust ABI is mandatory (untrusted document segments keep provenance and control-id exclusion). Presets/prompts versioned with hashes; eval re-run on any change. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Per-task eligibility record: instructions-before/after scorecard pair + cold-prefill equivalence receipt, archived per task/domain.
- PERF_LEDGER rows for measured pack speedups (p50/p95/p99) per host; no claim without a row.
- Negative outcomes recorded: tasks that fail the order gate are listed as pack-ineligible with their scorecard deltas.

## Tests
- Unit: pack manifest parsing/versioning; eligibility metadata enforcement (unqualified task in a pack request → typed error or standalone fallback).
- Property: pack execution produces per-task outputs identical in schema to standalone runs; structural witnesses sum correctly.
- E2E (model-gated, SKIPPED_NO_MODEL): run a two-task pack vs standalone on a fixture corpus; compare quality metrics and witness counts; detailed logging of prompt orders, prefill reuse, and equivalence checks.

## Dependencies & rationale
- wants A_TASKCORE: packs compose existing task-core surfaces and their segment ABI; nothing here exists without the task layer.

title: [P7] Run schema infer experiment with holdout utility measurement
description:
## Background
Backlog stretch (explicitly gated; NEVER blocks v1). `fnlp schema infer` would let the wedge model (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; SwiGLU 10752) propose an extraction schema from sample documents. Deferred to Phase 7 because a schema can be COMPILABLE yet semantically wrong for the user's data — "it compiles through the v1 subset" is not "it captures what the documents mean".

## Contract
- **Mechanism:** model-proposed schemas from sample documents, emitted ONLY within the normative v1 schema subset (types {object,array,string,number,integer,boolean,null}; enum/const; required + additionalProperties:false; finite maxItems and byte caps; no $ref/recursion/oneOf-anyOf-allOf/patternProperties) so every proposal is compilable by construction or rejected.
- **Compilable ≠ correct:** the surface is labeled experimental; output explicitly states that compilation success is not semantic correctness.
- **Holdout utility measurement:** the promotion experiment measures utility on HELD-OUT documents — extraction quality (field-F1 against reference labels or human judgment) using the inferred schema vs a human-written schema on documents the inference never saw. No promotion without that measured utility.
- Proposals are deterministic under fixed seed/profile (replayable); every proposal carries provenance (sample-document digests, prompt hash, recipe id).
- Pre-promotion, the command is absent or returns the versioned `surface_not_built` error per the frozen robot schema — never a success-shaped stub.

## Constraints
G8 discipline: an inferred schema that fails the v1 subset compiler is a typed rejection, not a "best effort" emission. Experimental surfaces never become defaults silently. Prompts versioned; eval re-run on change. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Holdout utility table: inferred-vs-human schema extraction quality on unseen documents, per domain, with confidence intervals on locked data.
- Compile-rate and rejection-taxonomy rows (how often proposals violate the subset and why).
- Promotion decision recorded either way; failure to beat a reasonable human baseline is a legitimate recorded outcome.

## Tests
- Unit: subset-conformance filter on proposals; provenance envelope.
- Property/fuzz: arbitrary model output → subset-compile-or-clean-error, never a dead/unbounded schema reaching the grammar engine.
- E2E (model-gated, SKIPPED_NO_MODEL): infer on a fixture document family, extract on holdout with the proposal, score against references; detailed logging of proposals, compile verdicts, and utility metrics.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Epic rollup only: builds entirely on the shipped schema compiler (Phase 4A) and extract task; gated by its own holdout experiment.

title: [P7] Build AA-A1 human-graded acceptance and decay audits
description:
## Background
Backlog stretch (explicitly gated; NEVER blocks v1). AA-A1: `fnlp audit plan/grade` gives a FROZEN owned durable job (from the §8.4 machinery over the wedge model, Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d) a statistically defensible acceptance or decay decision. Human authority is the point: model self-grading cannot authorize acceptance, and a sample is not authority by itself.

## Contract
- **Population:** one frozen, verified owned-job population only (journal-complete durable job). No audit over live streams or unverified corpora.
- **`audit plan`:** deterministically selects item ids from PREREGISTERED strata with known inclusion probabilities using SHA-256 ranking over `(job_digest, audit_seed, stratum, item_id)`; the audit seed is EXTERNALLY supplied and committed only AFTER population freeze (post-freeze external seed; ties break by canonical id; seed provenance/retries visible). Plan does NOT materialize text/results unless the operator explicitly requests a protected review pack.
- **`audit grade`:** accepts HUMAN-authorized labels ONLY. Model-derived signals may stratify, never grade. Missing/invalid grades FAIL CLOSED (no imputation).
- **Math:** exact finite-population/stratified estimation, independently derived and verified against golden exact enumerations on small finite populations; simulations are for design power only. Every accepted item has known nonzero inclusion probability when the design claims accepted-population risk.
- **Claim scope:** the output is a scoped error-rate decision for THAT job/population (or a longitudinal qualification-validity window), or `INSUFFICIENT_DATA` — never per-item correctness, never a universal certificate.
- **Immutability:** the receipt binds population, strata, estimator, risk thresholds, sample ids, grader provenance, and missing/invalid grades. Post-hoc stratum or threshold changes create a NEW audit; they never rewrite the old claim.
- Only AA-A1 may update accepted-population claims (review-spill corrections are selection-biased and cannot).

## Constraints
Doctrine #23 (human authority; frozen population; preregistered design). Privacy: review packs are explicit, protected materialization; no content in telemetry; per-job HMAC commitment discipline carries through. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Golden exact-enumeration fixtures: small populations where the finite-population interval is enumerable by hand — implementation must match exactly.
- Population/order invariance property for the SHA-256 ranking; seed-commit-after-freeze protocol fixture.
- Fail-closed fixtures: missing grade, model-signal-as-grade attempt, post-hoc stratum change — all rejected with typed errors.

## Tests
- Unit: ranking function (job_digest, audit_seed, stratum, item_id) → deterministic order incl. tie-break; inclusion-probability bookkeeping; estimator arithmetic vs goldens.
- Property: sampling invariant under item insertion order; every claim names its population digest and design; INSUFFICIENT_DATA on under-powered designs.
- E2E: full plan → protected review pack (explicit) → grade → receipt cycle on a fixture job; detailed logging of seed provenance, strata, selections, and the final scoped claim. Model-gated steps SKIPPED_NO_MODEL.

## Dependencies & rationale
- wants A_JOBS: the audited population is a frozen, verified durable job — the §8.4 jobs core (commitments, journal, verification) must exist first.

title: [P7] Build portable snapshot partition/merge and entity lineage
description:
## Background
Backlog stretch (explicitly gated; NEVER blocks v1). `fnlp job partition/merge` makes corpus snapshots portable across shards/hosts for the wedge model (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots). Portable receipts are useful only AFTER single-host jobs prove exact snapshot semantics — scope-correct cache authority (ItemLocal / PartitionReduce / CorpusGlobal) must already be demonstrated on one host before it is distributed.

## Contract
- **Precondition:** single-host scope semantics PROVEN FIRST (the Phase-4C dependency-scope mutation invariants green) before any partition/merge surface ships.
- **`partition`:** splits a frozen snapshot into shards carrying their slice of the snapshot commitment, item-id domain, and stage-scope metadata; shard receipts are self-describing.
- **Compatibility classes:** shards/results are mergeable only within an exact compatibility class (same ExecutionIdentity projection: artifact/packing, tokenizer/template/prompt/grammar/TaskIR incl. dependency scopes, task args, calibration/policy, numerics/sampling incl. effective seed + sampler version, output schema, engine semantic version).
- **`merge` refusal:** ANY compatibility mismatch refuses with a field-level diff (same discipline as `resume`); partial/forced merges do not exist. Merged PartitionReduce/CorpusGlobal outputs recompute against the complete merged child-set digest — never stitched from shard-local authority.
- **Entity lineage across snapshots:** cross-snapshot cluster lineage states are typed: `unchanged | new | retired | merge | split | ambiguous`; resolve cluster ids remain snapshot-qualified, and lineage links two snapshot authorities without pretending they are one.

## Constraints
Cache authority follows dependency scope (doctrine #25): ItemLocal may transfer exactly; reduce/global authority is only valid for the complete merged snapshot. Item-id uniqueness must hold across the MERGED snapshot (bounded external-sort/index re-proof at merge). Privacy: per-job HMAC commitment domains — merging jobs with different secrets is a designed operation (new commitment root), never silent mixing. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Partition→merge round-trip: partition a snapshot, execute shards, merge — semantic output ≡ the unpartitioned single-host job (ordered deterministic mode), byte-compared.
- Refusal matrix: every ExecutionIdentity field mutated one at a time → merge refuses with the exact field named.
- Lineage fixtures: constructed two-snapshot cases exercising all six lineage states deterministically.

## Tests
- Unit: shard receipt encode/decode; compatibility-class computation; lineage-state classifier on hand-built cluster pairs.
- Property: merge(partition(S)) ≡ S for the snapshot commitment and item-id domain; duplicate item ids across shards detected at merge.
- E2E (model-gated, SKIPPED_NO_MODEL): two-shard job on one host, merged, verified vs uninterrupted single job; detailed logging of shard digests, merge checks, recompute decisions, lineage output.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Durable jobs core (franken_nlp-040, A_JOBS): partitions/merges operate on the §8.4 snapshot-commitment / ExecutionIdentity / HMAC-commitment-domain / stage-scope machinery; the single-host dependency-scope proof is its exit evidence.
- Spool/journal commit protocol (franken_nlp-eas): merge/verify derive only from committed journal-authorized pointers, and merged outputs are staged/materialized under the same spool-first/journal-second discipline.
- v1 refusal surface (franken_nlp-zcr): v1 ships `fnlp job partition/merge` as a frozen-schema refusal; this bead replaces that refusal with the real implementation and must remain wire-compatible with the frozen schema.

title: [P7] Run AA-R1 local resident experiment, traces first
description:
## Background
Backlog stretch (explicitly gated; NEVER blocks v1). AA-R1: agent-heavy hosts may run many independent `fnlp` clients, each duplicating the multi-GB wedge weights (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 8,339,601,408 bf16 payload bytes; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots) and its thread pools. A local resident could multiplex — but a resident process is research, NOT permission to add a server.

## Contract
- **Traces FIRST:** the entry gate is evidence of repeated multi-process artifact loads, memory duplication, core oversubscription/pool contention, and latency on real agent-heavy hosts, plus EV = (Impact×Confidence×Reuse)/(Effort×AdoptionFriction) ≥ 2. No traces, no code.
- **Shape if promoted:** `fnlp resident start/status/stop` — an OWNER-ONLY, OS-LOCAL IPC endpoint multiplexing the EXISTING versioned framed robot contract (no second protocol). NEVER a routable listener; no remote credentials, ever.
- **Mechanics:** owner/peer permission checks on the endpoint; registry name-leases under the supervised tree (never an ambient service locator); per-client admission and cancellation; protocol version negotiation; drain/restart receipts; namespace-complete cache keys (no cross-client content reuse outside declared namespaces).
- **Equivalence:** every resident result ≡ the in-process batch-1 result for the same request/profile (result = batch-1 equivalence gate).
- **Fallback retained:** the in-process library/CLI and cooperating `fnlp batch` pipe remain fully supported; resident is opt-in and removable.
- **Portability constraint:** cross-platform local IPC must use approved suite/std surfaces — if no ratified safe surface exists, the card STAYS research (no new unsafe islands, no new dependencies).

## Constraints
Doctrine #27 verbatim-binding. Threat model: hostile local peers (disconnect mid-request, malformed frames, permission probing) are in scope; hostile-disconnect tests required. Memory admission is process-aggregate (one EngineResources ledger across all clients). Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Trace bundle + EV worksheet archived BEFORE implementation; a negative trace result graveyards the card (recorded in NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE — success outcome).
- If implemented: batch-1 equivalence differential; hostile-disconnect and permission matrices; drain/restart receipts; protocol-negotiation fixtures; no-routable-listener proof (endpoint type + bind audit).

## Tests
- Unit: name-lease lifecycle; per-client admission accounting; version negotiation.
- Property/fuzz: malformed frames from a client → typed per-client errors, resident survives; client kill mid-request → cancellation propagates, other clients unaffected.
- E2E (model-gated, SKIPPED_NO_MODEL): N concurrent clients vs N sequential in-process runs — identical results, measured RSS/latency deltas logged; detailed logging of admissions, leases, disconnects.

## Dependencies & rationale
- wants A_DAEMON: the resident multiplexes the hardened daemon's framed contract and sits under its supervised tree; that machinery must exist first.

title: [P7] Research AA-W1 cross-loop wavefront, occupancy traces first
description:
## Background
Backlog research (explicitly gated; NEVER blocks v1). AA-W1: in the wedge model (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d), the SAME physical layer weights serve loop 1 and loop 2 (22 physical layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; final RMSNorm after each pass). Different ready sequences sitting at physical layer i in DIFFERENT semantic loops could share one weight sweep for linear work — but only if measured loop-stage fragmentation actually exists.

## Contract
- **Trace FIRST:** before any code, trace loop-stage occupancy and partial weight sweeps in the production scheduler under R2/R3 workloads. If batches run in dense lockstep (all sequences at the same loop/stage), the opportunity is ZERO and the card is graveyarded — negative evidence is success.
- **If fragmentation exists and EV ≥ 2:** implement LINEAR-WORK-ONLY sharing — q/k/v/o and MLP matrix work may coalesce compatible rows across loops; attention state, KV destinations, and dependencies remain LOOP-TAGGED (KV slot = layer + loop×22; never mixed).
- **Hard exclusions:** never parallelize the two loops of ONE sequence (loop 2 consumes loop-1 normalized output — a strict dependency); never delay latency-bound work to manufacture a coalescing pair.
- **Proof obligations:** model-check the readiness DAG (bounded); split linear vs stateful compatibility keys; prove EVERY sequence's results ≡ loop-major execution (exact differential); demonstrate fewer partial weight sweeps AND R2/R3 p50/p95/p99/energy wins in randomized paired A/B.
- **Fallback:** ordinary loop-major compatibility key including `loop` — the shipped default until (and unless) every gate passes.

## Constraints
The loop is the architecture (doctrine #3): 22→norm→22→norm; L2 ladder has 44 layer outputs + two norm states; scheduling never treats this as a conventional 22-layer model. One card, one causal change, one ledger entry; fixed profile budget — exhaustion means no promotion. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Occupancy trace bundle + EV worksheet archived before implementation; graveyard record in NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE if lockstep/no-win (a legitimate terminal outcome).
- If implemented: bounded readiness-DAG model-check artifact; per-sequence loop-major equivalence differential (exact under the named profile); partial-sweep counter deltas; paired A/B distributions.

## Tests
- Trace harness meta-tests: occupancy instrumentation does not perturb semantics (traced ≡ untraced outputs).
- If implemented — unit: compatibility-key split (linear vs stateful); loop-tag preservation on every KV write (slot = layer + loop×22 asserted).
- Property/differential: shuffled multi-sequence workloads → per-sequence outputs byte-equal to loop-major execution; cancellation mid-coalesced-sweep leaves survivors correct.
- Detailed logging of coalescing decisions, sweep counts, and loop tags; model-gated rows SKIPPED_NO_MODEL.

## Dependencies & rationale
- Typed step DAG scheduler (franken_nlp-4zh): the occupancy traces instrument, and any coalescing would modify, that scheduler's readiness DAG and morsel execution — the experiment cannot begin before it exists.
- No other blockers: the go/no-go gate is this bead's own trace evidence, not another bead.

title: [P7] Research AA-D1 exact loop-draft speculation
description:
## Background
Backlog research (explicitly gated; NEVER blocks v1; high risk). AA-D1: the wedge model's loop structure (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 physical layers × 2 loops → 44 layer executions per token position; final RMSNorm after each pass; vocab 166,144; untied lm_head) suggests a free-ish draft: loop-1 output projected through lm_head proposes tokens; the full two-loop target verifies them speculatively. Exact or graveyard — nothing in between ships.

## Contract
- **Order of proof:** (1) prove the acceptance algorithm ALGEBRAICALLY (the standard exact speculative-decoding acceptance rule preserving the target distribution exactly); (2) validate against a TINY ENUMERATED model where every distribution is computable by hand; (3) only then implement against the real model with token-stream/distribution differentials, acceptance/waste profiling, and full L4/L5 gates.
- **Exactness:** the acceptance rule preserves the target token distribution EXACTLY (greedy streams byte-identical; sampled streams distribution-identical under §6.10 semantics). Confidence-threshold acceptance is explicitly APPROXIMATE and MAY NOT use this card's name or ship under it.
- **Honest cost accounting:** loop-1 lm_head cost (a 166,144-row projection per drafted position) is COUNTED — structural witnesses record `draft_loop1` (one loop pass + its projection) separately from `target_full` (exactly 2 loop passes / 44 physical-layer executions per position); a draft invocation can never be mislabeled a target invocation. Loss accounting includes target calls, wasted draft work, and p99.
- **Disposition:** if no exact verifier emerges, or the net win (after draft lm_head cost) is absent, record the graveyard result in NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE — a legitimate terminal outcome.
- **Fallback:** ordinary two-loop decoding, always retained.

## Constraints
Exact loop speculation or graveyard it (Alien-Artifact contract). G1>G2: the token distribution contract is absolute; no approximate mode may borrow this name. OPERATION_COSTS.json witness discipline (doctrine #30). Fixed research budget declared before starting; exhaustion = no promotion. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; no Rayon.

## Evidence / gates
- Algebraic proof memo + tiny-enumerated-model validation (every acceptance branch exercised against hand-computed distributions) BEFORE real-model code.
- Token-stream differential: greedy byte-identity vs ordinary decoding on frozen prefixes; sampled-distribution tests under fixed seeds.
- Acceptance/waste profile + paired A/B latency distributions counting draft lm_head cost; L4/L5 green; witness fixtures proving draft_loop1 vs target_full separation.

## Tests
- Unit: acceptance-rule arithmetic on enumerated distributions (goldens); witness counter emission.
- Property: for every prefix and seed, speculative output ≡ non-speculative output (greedy exact; sampled via distribution tests over many seeds).
- E2E (model-gated, SKIPPED_NO_MODEL): decode fixtures with speculation on/off; detailed logging of proposals, accept/reject decisions, waste, and witness counts.

## Dependencies & rationale
- wants A_SAMPLER: the exact acceptance rule composes with the addressable sampler's distribution semantics (seeded streams, §6.10 spaces); speculation must preserve exactly what the sampler defines.

title: [P7] Stage ft-kernel-metal Apple-GPU track; park serve and translation
description:
## Background
Backlog stretch (explicitly gated; NEVER blocks v1). Owner-affirmed track (ruling 2026-07-31): Apple-GPU acceleration for the wedge model (Nanbeige4.2-3B @ f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d; 22 layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots; final RMSNorm after each pass; head_dim 128 explicit; vocab 166,144; SwiGLU 10752) via `ft-kernel-metal` over unified memory. CPU remains the reference implementation, correctness authority, and portable product floor; CUDA stays out of scope entirely. This bead also parks two adjacent decisions: `fnlp serve` and translation.

## Contract
- **Metal track (ft-kernel-metal):** lands only AFTER the CPU core is parity-proven (post-CPU-parity precondition is absolute). Prefill first — the compute-bound stage where an integrated GPU over unified memory can plausibly win; decode remains CPU until separately proven.
- **Own numerics profile:** GPU execution gets its own NAMED §1.1.1 numerics profile (it is not hf-bf16-eager and inherits no CPU profile's claims) and passes the SAME L-ladder gate structure under that profile (L0 exact where integer, named tolerance vectors for floating stages, L2 across all 44 layer outputs + two loop-norm states, L4/L5 under the GPU profile's contracts).
- **Authority:** CPU stays the correctness authority and portable floor; the GPU path NEVER becomes a requirement — every surface works CPU-only; GPU is opt-in acceleration with a measured, honest ledger (fair A/B vs the proven CPU path on the same host).
- **`fnlp serve` (remote/routable):** explicitly a SEPARATE LATER DECISION — not part of this track, not implied by resident/AA-R1, not designed here; recorded as out-of-scope until its own decision.
- **Translation task:** enters only AFTER multilingual evals exist (task-quality evidence first); until then it is not a surface.

## Constraints
Non-goals enforced at review (no premature GPU work before CPU parity; no routable server; one model, one product). Any Metal work must fit the dependency doctrine (a pinned FrankenSuite surface — ft-kernel-metal — not an ad-hoc Metal binding); unsafe stays in enumerated islands; no Rayon. Fidelity claims are profile-scoped; GPU numbers never launder into CPU claims. Deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite.

## Evidence / gates
- Entry gate record: CPU parity certification (the P6 gauntlet) green BEFORE any Metal kernel lands.
- GPU profile definition committed (cast points, tolerance vectors) + L-ladder results under that profile; prefill A/B distributions (p50/p95/p99, energy where available) vs CPU on the same host in PERF_LEDGER.
- serve/translation decision records (explicit deferral entries, revisit conditions) so scope creep has a named gate to argue with.

## Tests
- Differential: GPU prefill vs CPU reference per-op and end-to-end under the GPU profile's named tolerances; all 44 layer outputs + two norm states in the L2 harness.
- Property: CPU-only builds/hosts unaffected (feature-gated compilation; absent GPU → identical CPU behavior).
- E2E (model-gated, SKIPPED_NO_MODEL; GPU-gated additionally reporting a typed skip on non-Apple hosts): frozen-prefix prefill on GPU then CPU decode, output equivalence under the declared profile; detailed logging of dispatch decisions and tolerances.

## Dependencies & rationale
- wants A_DISPATCH: the measured dispatch/selection machinery must exist so a GPU path enters as a dispatched, measured, revertible choice — never a hardcoded route.

title: [P-1] Build scripts/fetch_model.sh + .ps1 pinned-source fetchers (journal resume, quarantine, --check-only)
description:
## Background
Out-of-band provisioning tools that download the immutable upstream conversion closure for the one-model wedge: Nanbeige4.2-3B @ HF rev f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d (22 physical layers × 2 loops, KV slot = layer + loop×22 → 44 slots, final RMSNorm after EACH pass, head_dim 128 EXPLICIT (q 3072→6144), vocab 166,144, untied lm_head, SwiGLU 10752, RoPE θ=7e7 split-half). These scripts feed `fnlp convert` and the truth pack; they are NEVER the end-user installer and never run at inference time. Patterned on FrankenOCR's Baidu fetcher.

## Contract
