title: [P5] Stage AA-K1 certified fixed-shape kernel-search spike behind hotspot and EV gates
description:
## Background
AA-K1 "certified fixed-shape kernel search" is the highest-reuse alien-artifact card: an OFFLINE search — state = model shape + ISA + cache fingerprint; actions = bounded tile/unroll/packing/fusion candidates; loss = weighted p50/p95/p99 + code size subject to exact/tolerance constraints — over the wedge's fixed weight-side shapes (Nanbeige4.2-3B at HF rev f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d: weight-side GEMM K ∈ {3072, 6144, 10752} with N fixed per projection (1024 is the k/v output width N, never a K); hidden 3072, q 3072→6144, k/v 3072→1024, MLP 3072→10752→3072, lm_head 3072→166,144; 22×2 loops double every weight visit; head_dim 128 EXPLICIT). It is normalize→enumerate/rewrite→verify, NOT a runtime optimizer. Like the other gated AA spikes it may enter implementation ONLY when a measured GEMM/GEMV hotspot maps to it and EV = (Impact×Confidence×Reuse)/(Effort×AdoptionFriction) ≥ 2 with integer factors 1–5 and one-sentence evidence each.

## Contract
- **Entry gate first**: a profile names a persisting GEMM/GEMV hotspot that the hand-written prepacked kernels + measured dispatch table have not closed; EV ≥ 2 recorded. No hotspot → this bead closes as "not entered" with the negative record (an acceptable outcome).
- **Search manifest**: fixed candidate space (tile sizes over the fixed K/N geometries, unroll factors, packing interleaves, epilogue fusions already in the proved catalog), fixed profile/search budget declared BEFORE execution — exhaustion means no promotion, never a best-so-far default.
- **Certification per candidate**: generated kernels carry a scalar/i64 differential certificate over exhaustive small-K pairs + adversarial full-K vectors (i32 bounds at K=10752: S8×S8 ≤176,160,768; raw U8×S8 ≤350,945,280; +correction ≤176,160,768; sum 527,106,048 < 2^31−1) and every masked-tail case at 0,1,W−1,W,W+1; the canonical quant algebra (s8, zero-point 0, XOR-0x80 offset correction with exact 128·Σw subtraction, fixed reduction order) is preserved bit-exactly.
- **Evidence bundle**: search manifest, candidate graph, generated-code digest, compiler/host pin, randomized paired A/B gauntlet through thermal steady state (p50/p95/p99, energy where available, code-size cost). Generated source is human-reviewed and reproducible from the manifest; no regex mass edit lands.
- **Promotion**: a winning kernel enters the measured dispatch table as an ordinary row (keyed by ISA/shape/regime) with the same keep-gate as hand kernels; losers are reverted with the full record in docs/NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE.md. Deterministic fallback is always the current hand-written scalar/prepacked kernel + measured dispatch table.

## Constraints
Profile-first (no hotspot → no change); one card, one causal change, one ledger entry; raw saturating vpmaddubsw remains banned on AVX2 (only the exact low-7/high-bit or sign-extend decompositions are legal candidate forms); AVX2 is never allowed a different answer than the canonical algebra; measured-faster wins — capability is not routing; composition budget: no subsystem stacks more than three mathematical families; generated kernels live in the same enumerated-island policy as hand SIMD (unsafe only inside audited islands); no Rayon; deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite — the search tooling stays OUTSIDE the release dependency graph.

## Evidence / gates
Closes on ONE of: (a) promotion — dispatch-table row(s) with the full evidence bundle (env.json, manifest.json, repro.lock; LEGAL.md if any paper/external implementation informed the search, with primary-source review status) and PERF_LEDGER entry; or (b) graveyard — NEGATIVE_EVIDENCE entry with the search budget, best candidates, and why the keep-gate failed; or (c) not-entered — the recommendation record showing no qualifying hotspot/EV. Every path leaves the recommendation record (hotspot evidence, EV factors, equations/units, assumptions, interaction matrix, rollback command).

## Tests
Unit: manifest schema + budget accounting (search halts exactly at budget). Differential: every generated candidate vs scalar/i64 oracle on the exhaustive/adversarial suites BEFORE any benchmark counts; tail masks at page boundaries. Property: regenerating from the manifest reproduces byte-identical source (generated-code digest stable). Bench: randomized interleaved A/B with warmup/thermal preflight; results feed the ledger schema. Detailed logging: per-candidate compile/verify/bench outcomes with digests so the search is auditable offline. Model-gated end-to-end forward comparisons report SKIPPED_NO_MODEL without weights.

## Dependencies & rationale
- A_DISPATCH (cross-epic want): the measured dispatch-table framework is both the baseline the search must beat and the promotion target for any winner.

title: [P6] Resolve OQ-15: long-context R4 practicality measurement gating every >8K claim
description:
## Background
OQ-15 (state PARTIAL / R4 empirical; blocks every >8K-context claim): the pinned config/plain-RoPE advertises 262,144 positions for Nanbeige4.2-3B (HF rev f56ec5a9650268aa098496734743c25ea778bd2d), but acceptance is not usability — with 22 physical layers × 2 loops → 44 KV slots (KV slot = layer + loop×22; final RMSNorm after EACH pass; head_dim 128 EXPLICIT; 8 KV heads), bf16 KV costs 176 KiB/token (180,224 B across 44 slots): 8K ≈ 1.38 GiB, 32K ≈ 5.5 GiB, 262,144 ≈ 44 GiB per sequence before activations. Full attention is quadratic in prefill, so map-reduce is a primary operating mode rather than an edge case. The default per-sequence context cap is 8192 governed by the exact admission certificate. Nobody owns resolving OQ-15's remaining portion: verify long-context behavior against the HF oracle and tested official upstream, and publish the time/KV/RSS practicality table that R4 claims and wording must cite.

## Contract
- **Reference verification**: on the pinned oracle closure (eager attention, recorded thread counts) and the tested official `llama.cpp` baseline, run matched long-context fixtures at preregistered context points selected from admitted memory on the host — never hard-coded to 32K when it cannot fit — confirming the model actually accepts and produces stable outputs at those lengths (greedy prefix agreement per the L4 scoping rules; any instability recorded per the nondeterminism-floor protocol, no unstable suffix promoted as golden).
- **Practicality table**: per (host fingerprint, artifact recipe, packing set, kv dtype, context point): prefill time, decode tok/s at depth, exact KV bytes (payload + scale + padding + page-table overhead when int8 KV is measured), peak RSS, and the admission certificate's committed/peak terms from `robot plan --ctx --batch --quant` — published in the per-regime (R4) ledger with p50/p95/p99.
- **Claim gating**: README/help/release wording about contexts >8K may cite ONLY rows in this table via claim ids; 262,144 is always described as an observed model limit, never a practicality promise; hosts without measurements say "not measured", never extrapolate.
- **Boundary semantics**: admission at, just below, and just above the configured cap (8192 default; explicitly raised caps) is exercised so the certificate's rejection reasons are exact; the R4 cancellation-latency requirement (no monopolizing a whole 200K-token prefill; bounded morsels) is measured at the long points.
- OQ-15 flips PARTIAL → resolved-for-its-remaining-portion in the research-decision register with this evidence.

## Constraints
Never conflate acceptance with usability (doctrine); admission is governed by the exact memory certificate, not one ambiguous number — the invariant never compares KV alone against a budget that excludes the 4–10 GB model/packing residency; measured DRAM/traffic numbers are labeled per the honest-denominator rules (no STREAM/TOPS as attainable denominators); fixtures/tolerances follow the profile-scoped L-gate contracts; no Rayon; deps only clap/serde/serde_json/sha2 + pinned FrankenSuite; G1>G2.

## Evidence / gates
Closes on: (a) oracle + official-upstream long-context fixture runs archived with exact commands/env and context points; (b) the R4 practicality table in docs/PERF_LEDGER.md keyed by host/recipe/packing/kv-dtype/context; (c) claim-registry entries for every public >8K statement bound to table rows (CI wording enforcement passes); (d) admission boundary fixtures green with exact rejection terms; (e) the research-decision register updated. The release gauntlet's R4 pillar consumes this bead's fixtures/table.

## Tests
Unit: context-point selection from admitted memory (never emits a point the certificate rejects); table schema validation (duplicate-key-rejecting canonical JSON). Integration: `robot plan` terms at each context point match the measured allocations within the documented accounting; cancellation-observation latency at the longest admitted prefill meets the declared quantum bounds. E2E (model-gated, SKIPPED_NO_MODEL otherwise, on at least one Apple and one x86-64 host): matched fixture at ≥2 long points vs oracle greedy prefixes. Detailed logging: per-point KV page counts, slab classes, and peak-RSS samples in the telemetry envelope.

## Dependencies & rationale
- A_ORACLE (cross-epic want): the pinned CPU oracle closure generates the long-context reference runs this bead compares against.
